'''Vald Inosp''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He fell to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] and was present on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] where he met his [[Death/Legends|demise]] at the hands of a [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]] while he was investigating a [[Datacron/Legends|Rakata Datacron]] in the [[Tomb of Tulak Hord]] that contained a Red Matrix Shard.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vald Inosp appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on Korriban. He is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.<ref name="TOR" />

Unlike other Champion bosses, Inosp will only appear after a server resets or updates. Once he is defeated by any player, he will not spawn again until the server resets or updates once more, making him a particularly rare encounter.<ref name="TOR" />
